name: 사진만

day.desc: 날 여는 쪽의 날 줄 '장소, 날짜' (y=3, x=4, h=2)

css: .t-photo .pg.bg-paper{background:#F4F2ED}.t-photo .pg.bg-dark{background:#121211}.t-photo .tx{font-family:Pretendard,'Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;color:#1a1a18;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap}.t-photo .bg-dark .tx{color:#d8d6d0}.t-photo .r-title{font-size:9cqw;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.t-photo .r-title:not(.onp){color:#1a1a18;text-shadow:none}.t-photo .r-period{font-size:3.2cqw;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.04em}.t-photo .r-period:not(.onp){color:#55534e}.t-photo .onp{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 1.5cqw rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.t-photo .r-day{font-size:2.8cqw;color:#6b6963;letter-spacing:.02em}.t-photo .ix{position:absolute;left:8.33%;right:8.33%;top:12.5%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:2cqw 1.6cqw}.t-photo .ix figure{position:static;margin:0}.t-photo .ix img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;object-position:left bottom;display:block}.t-photo .ix figcaption{font:2.4cqw Pretendard,sans-serif;color:#7a7872;margin-top:.8cqw}
